mapper.select: SELECT project_id FROM review_project ORDER BY project_id

SELECT DATE(finished_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(1) AS task_total, SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS task_success, SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS task_failed, SUM(CASE WHEN event_source = 'PUSH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS task_push FROM review_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND task_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') AND finished_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(finished_time) >= #{beginDate} AND DATE(finished_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(finished_time)

SELECT duration_ms FROM review_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND task_status = 'SUCCESS' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND finished_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(finished_time) = #{statDate} ORDER BY duration_ms ASC

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS stat_date, COUNT(1) AS issue_new, SUM(CASE WHEN severity = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_critical, SUM(CASE WHEN severity = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_high, SUM(CASE WHEN severity = 'MEDIUM' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_medium, SUM(CASE WHEN severity = 'LOW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_low FROM review_issue WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND origin = 'NEW' AND create_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(create_time) >= #{beginDate} AND DATE(create_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time)
SELECT MAX(finished_time) FROM review_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND task_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED')

SELECT DATE(finished_time) AS stat_date, pr_author AS author_key, COUNT(1) AS tasks_reviewed FROM review_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND pr_author IS NOT NULL AND pr_author != '' AND task_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') AND finished_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(finished_time) >= #{beginDate} AND DATE(finished_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(finished_time), pr_author

SELECT DATE(finished_time) AS stat_date, pr_author AS author_key, COALESCE(SUM(additions), 0) AS additions_sum, COALESCE(SUM(deletions), 0) AS deletions_sum FROM review_task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND pr_author IS NOT NULL AND pr_author != '' AND task_status = 'SUCCESS' AND finished_time IS NOT NULL AND (additions IS NOT NULL OR deletions IS NOT NULL) AND DATE(finished_time) >= #{beginDate} AND DATE(finished_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(finished_time), pr_author

SELECT DATE(i.create_time) AS stat_date, t.pr_author AS author_key, COUNT(1) AS issues_new FROM review_issue i INNER JOIN review_task t ON t.task_id = i.first_task_id WHERE i.project_id = #{projectId} AND i.origin = 'NEW' AND t.pr_author IS NOT NULL AND t.pr_author != '' AND i.create_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(i.create_time) >= #{beginDate} AND DATE(i.create_time) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(i.create_time), t.pr_author

SELECT t.pr_author AS author_key, COUNT(1) AS issues_open FROM review_issue i INNER JOIN review_task t ON t.task_id = i.last_task_id WHERE i.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.pr_author IS NOT NULL AND t.pr_author != '' AND DATE(i.create_time) <= #{asOfDate} AND ( i.status IN ('AWAITING_CONFIRM', 'AWAITING_FIX', 'RECHECKING') OR (i.closed_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(i.closed_time) > #{asOfDate}) ) GROUP BY t.pr_author
